inherited_release_gate.note: All sealed dev2 donor-free GMX vertex/material schema synthesis, dev1 integrated mod staging, dev28 TXIF graph, dev27 scene graph, dev26 mesh graph, dev25 retail GMX evidence, native builders, extraction/research and source-only gates are inherited. dev3 removes the native TEX same-layout donor requirement for the confirmed canonical platform layouts.

fresh_package.note: Candidate was extracted fresh, verified against RELEASE_MANIFEST with no unlisted files, source-audited before executing package code, and then passed 77/77 selftests plus CLI/GUI version checks. Final package is rebuilt deterministically after recording this evidence.

limitations: Compressed/mipmapped native texture variants are not synthesized.
PS3 donor-free wrapper synthesis is structurally validated but arbitrary runtime acceptance is not yet hardware/emulator-proven.
MOTN/ANIM graph synthesis/import, platform shader compilation, remaining opaque chunk semantics, and fully template-free GMX root creation remain unresolved.
Runtime acceptance of arbitrary donor-free synthesized models/textures remains a separate hardware/emulator gate.
The external dev25 306/306 retail GMX evidence is inherited rather than re-run from proprietary inputs.
PS3 NPDRM/SDAT re-encryption is not implemented.
